description: Tell AgentReader that a read failed or looked wrong (empty, not the main content, cut off, blocked although readable, ...), so we can fix it. Free, never charged, max 10 per day. We store the URL without its query string, the reason and your short note for 90 days; don't put personal data in the note.

note.description: What you expected or what was wrong (max 300 characters; longer notes are cut)

reason.description: empty (little or no text), wrong_content (not the page's main content), missing_part (content cut off or missing), blocked_wrongly (error although the page is readable), too_long (too much boilerplate), error (unexpected error), other

url.description: The page whose read went wrong

name: report_issue
title: Report a bad read
